question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '**Monark**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Monark**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Monarch**'.
 
• It means 'a king or queen'. (राजा या रानी, शासक, अधिपति)
 
 
• *Example: They showed ways of behaving, and of surviving, at the court of an absolute **monarch**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Monark.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Hover**: (used about a bird, etc.) to stay in the air in one place. [(पक्षी, विमान आदि का) आकाश में मँडराना]
 
• **Dreary**: not at all interesting or attractive; boring. (नीरस या अनाकर्षक; उबाऊ)
 
• **Adorn**: to add something in order to make a thing or person more attractive or beautiful. (अधिक आकर्षक या मोहक बनाने के लिए सजाना)
